landing.cta.note.en: Free forever - No credit card needed - Set up in 30 seconds

landing.cta.subtitle.en: Join thousands of people who've already simplified their gifting with Wishlane. It's free, it's beautiful, and it just works.

landing.discover.subtitle.en: Explore your friends' wishlists, see upcoming events, and never show up empty-handed.

landing.features.card1.desc.en: Create stunning wishlists with custom colors, descriptions, and event dates. Choose from five accent colors to make each list unique.

landing.features.card2.desc.en: Paste any product URL and Wishlane auto-fills the title, description, image, and price.

landing.features.card3.desc.en: Connect with friends via invite links or username search. Share wishlists publicly, with friends only, or keep them private.

landing.features.card4.desc.en: Reserve items on friends' wishlists so nobody buys the same gift. Only you can see your reservations.

landing.features.card5.desc.en: Get notified when friends add wishlists, send requests, or reserve an item.

landing.features.card6.desc.en: Browse friends' public wishlists, see upcoming events with countdowns, and find the right gift.

landing.features.subtitle.en: From creating wishlists to discovering what your friends want - Wishlane handles every part of the gifting journey.

landing.hero.note.en: Free forever - No credit card required

landing.hero.subtitle.en: Create stunning wishlists, share them with friends and family, and never miss the perfect gift again. Wishlane makes every occasion unforgettable.

landing.how.step1.desc.en: Name it, pick a color, set an event date, and choose who can see it. Add items by pasting links and Wishlane fills the details.

landing.how.step2.desc.en: Invite friends by sharing your unique link or searching their username. They will see your wishlists and you will see theirs.

landing.how.step3.desc.en: Browse friends' wishlists and reserve items secretly. No duplicate gifts and no ruined surprises.

landing.how.subtitle.en: Getting started with Wishlane is as easy as making a wish.

landing.testimonials.quote1.en: Wishlane changed how our family does holidays. No more duplicate gifts and everyone knows what to get.

landing.testimonials.quote2.en: The link scraping feature is magic. I paste an Amazon link and everything fills in automatically.

landing.testimonials.quote3.en: I love the reservation system. I can claim a gift and nobody else sees it, so surprises stay intact.

subscription.faq.cancel.a.en: Yes! You can cancel at any time from your subscription page. You'll keep Pro access until the end of your current billing period.

subscription.faq.cancel.q.en: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?

subscription.faq.downgrade.a.en: Your wishlists and items are never deleted. If you exceed the free limits (5 wishlists, 20 items per wishlist), the extra ones become read-only — you can still view them but won't be able to edit or add new ones until you're within the limits or upgrade again.

subscription.faq.downgrade.q.en: What happens to my data if I downgrade?

subscription.faq.payment.a.en: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express) and other methods through our payment provider. Your subscription will also work across our mobile app when it launches.

subscription.faq.refund.a.en: If you're unhappy with Pro, contact us within your first 7 days and we'll issue a full refund. After that, you can cancel anytime and continue using Pro until the end of your billing period.

subscription.faq.refund.q.en: Do I get a refund if I'm not satisfied?

subscription.faq.trial.a.en: We don't offer a trial, but the Free plan is fully functional for casual use. You can upgrade to Pro whenever you're ready for unlimited wishlists, sale alerts, and more.

subscription.faq.trial.q.en: Is there a free trial for Pro?
